record.notes: The unlimited-transfer claim comes from a third-party table and is not on the vendor price page read, so it is recorded as reported. A 2011 blog describes a fifteen-day free trial with a 5 Mbps downstream cap on this product; the current third-party comparison says no trial exists, and the vendor page does not mention one, so the trial is treated as withdrawn rather than current. The two sources disagree and the newer one wins, which is the finding.
